meta.ci_method: cluster bootstrap over tasks (repositories fixed), per-task value = 3-seed mean TSR, percentile 2.5/97.5; one shared task-index matrix per (corpus, task_type[, subset]) group
meta.p_value: two-sided paired bootstrap: p = min(1, 2*min(P(d<=0), P(d>=0))) over the 10,000 deltas; p = 0 means no bootstrap delta reached zero (resolution 1e-4); identical vectors give p = 1
meta.holm_family: the 21 pairs within each (corpus, task_type) group; multi-symbol T2 is a separate family
meta.significant: p_holm < 0.05 and the delta CI excludes 0
meta.latency: l_e2e_ms per cell (retrieve + generate; indexing excluded)
